capabilities.name: Strict emergency command validation
capabilities.description: Validates bounded command envelopes, scope, epoch, action, expiry and resume approval structure.
limitations: Does not verify cryptographic signatures or identity claims.

capabilities.name: Deterministic stop/resume state reducer
capabilities.description: Evaluates monotonic per-scope STOP and controlled RESUME transitions against explicitly supplied verification evidence.
limitations: Pure reference logic only; no durable state, propagation, revocation or enforcement.

explicit_non_capabilities: Cryptographic signature verification or key management
Durable authoritative state or distributed consensus
Distributed stop propagation or agent acknowledgement
Process quarantine, termination or runtime enforcement
